school_immunizations.name: PopHIVE school immunization assessments
school_immunizations.organization: PopHIVE, Yale School of Public Health
school_immunizations.location: Per-state standard files and source notes
school_immunizations.description: State health departments publish the results of their annual school immunization assessments in different formats, including open data portals, workbooks, and PDF reports. The PopHIVE school_immunizations repository standardizes each state's files by school year, county, and grade. This source includes the eight states that publish Tdap, MenACWY, or HPV coverage for 6th or 7th graders or adolescents. Coverage definitions, the grade assessed, and denominators vary by state, so rates are best compared within a state over time. Connecticut reports by county through 2023-24 and by planning region from 2024-25. Washington assessed 6th grade through 2019-20 and 7th grade from 2020-21.
school_immunizations.restrictions: Public data published by the state agencies; no access restrictions. Cite the state source for a given state.
